name: Oscillator capacitor fault
mechanism: Y1/C1 | 8 MHz crystal unstable or missing

name: SPI flash trace via open
mechanism: V11/SPI_DATA | Internal firmware runs, external 8MB SPI flash fails
repair: Restore open via and test bus

name: Defective reset pull-up resistor
mechanism: R_RESET | Reset stuck low or noisy, boot blocked
repair: Replace resistor and verify reset release
